```{r A Tyding}
A <- A |> 
   slice(-(1:15)) |> 
  rename(
    State = 1,
    University = 2,
    `2020` = 3,
    `2021` = 4,
    `2022` = 5,
    `2023` = 6,
    `2024` = 7
  )
A <-  A |> 
  filter(!is.na(State)) |> 
  select(-University)
A <-  A |> 
   mutate(
    across(`2020`:`2024`, as.numeric),
    Average = rowMeans(pick(`2020`:`2024`), na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |> 
  relocate(Average, .before = "2020") |> 
  filter(State != "Grand Total") |> 
  mutate(State = reorder(State, Average))
```

```{r Rank Bar Chart Tab 1}
ggplot(A, aes(x = Average, y = reorder(State, Average))) +
  geom_col(fill = "#2C7A7B") +
  labs(
    x = "Average Enrolments (2020–2024)",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r Map Insert}
aus <- rnaturalearth::ne_states(
  country = "Australia",
  returnclass = "sf"
)
aus <- aus |>
  filter(name %in% c(
    "New South Wales",
    "Victoria",
    "Queensland",
    "Western Australia",
    "South Australia",
    "Tasmania",
    "Northern Territory",
    "Australian Capital Territory"
  ))
A_map <- A |>
  mutate(State = trimws(gsub("\u00A0", " ", State))) |>
  filter(State != "Multi-State")

aus_map <- aus |>
  left_join(A_map, by = c("name" = "State"))
```

```{r Australian Map Tab 1}
ggplot(aus_map) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = Average), colour = "white") +
  scale_fill_gradient(
    low = "#B8D8D8",
    high = "#243B53",
    name = "Average Enrolments"
  ) +
  theme_void()
```


```{r B Tyding}
B_selected <-  B |> 
  slice(2:4) |> 
  select(31:60, 72:103) 

years <- as.character(unlist(B_selected[2, ]))
values <- as.numeric(unlist(B_selected[3, ]))

B_long <- data.frame(
  Year = years,
  Access_Rate = values
)


B_equity <-  B_long |>
  mutate(
    Equity_Group = case_when(
      row_number() %in% 1:14 ~ "First Nations",
      row_number() %in% 15:30 ~ "Low SES by SA1",
      row_number() %in% 31:46 ~ "Regional",
      TRUE ~ "Remote"
    )
  ) |>
  select(Equity_Group, everything())
B_equity <- B_equity |>
  mutate(
    Year = as.integer(substr(as.character(Year), 1, 4))
  ) |>
  group_by(Equity_Group, Year) |>
  summarise(
    Access_Rate = mean(Access_Rate, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
B_equity <- B_equity |>
  mutate(
    Year = as.integer(substr(as.character(Year), 1, 4))
  ) |>
  group_by(Equity_Group, Year) |>
  summarise(
    Access_Rate = mean(Access_Rate, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r B_heatmap Creation}
B_heatmap <- B_equity |>
  mutate(
    Period = case_when(
      Year >= 2011 & Year <= 2014 ~ "2011–2014",
      Year >= 2015 & Year <= 2018 ~ "2015–2018",
      Year >= 2019 & Year <= 2022 ~ "2019–2022",
      Year >= 2023 & Year <= 2024 ~ "2023–2024"
    )
  ) |>
  group_by(Equity_Group, Period) |>
  summarise(
    Average_Access_Rate = mean(Access_Rate, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r Heatmap Chart Tab 2}
ggplot(B_heatmap, aes(
  x = Period,
  y = Equity_Group,
  fill = Average_Access_Rate
)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = round(Average_Access_Rate, 2)),
    color = "#243B53",
    size = 4
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradient(
    low = "#B8D8D8",
    high = "#243B53",
    name = "Average\nAccess Rate"
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    limits = c("2011–2014", "2015–2018", "2019–2022", "2023–2024")
  ) +
  scale_y_discrete(
    limits = rev(c(
     "Remote",
    "First Nations",
    "Low SES by SA1",
    "Regional"
    ))
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Educational Access Across Equity Groups",
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL
  ) +
  coord_fixed() +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "#F7F9F9", color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#F7F9F9", color = NA),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(
      color = "#243B53",
      face = "bold",
      size = 16
    ),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "#243B53", size = 10),
    legend.title = element_text(color = "#243B53"),
    legend.text = element_text(color = "#243B53")
  )
```


```{r C_dodge Creation}

years <- as.character(unlist(C_selected[2, ]))
values <- as.numeric(unlist(C_selected[3, ]))

C_long <- data.frame(
  Year = years,
  Participation_Rate = values
)

C_equity <-  C_long |>
  mutate(
    Equity_Group = case_when(
      row_number() %in% 1:14 ~ "First Nations",
      row_number() %in% 15:30 ~ "Low SES by SA1",

C_equity <- C_equity |>

    Year = as.integer(substr(as.character(Year), 1, 4))
  ) |>
  group_by(Equity_Group, Year) |>
  summarise(

C_dodge <- C_equity |>
```

```{r E_radial Creation}
E_selected <- E |> 
  slice(2:4) |> 
  select(45:74, 86:117)

years <- as.character(unlist(E_selected[2, ]))
values <- as.numeric(unlist(E_selected[3, ]))

E_long <- data.frame(
  Year = years,
  Success_Rate = values
)

E_equity <-  E_long |>
  mutate(
    Equity_Group = case_when(
      row_number() %in% 1:14 ~ "First Nations",
      row_number() %in% 15:30 ~ "Low SES by SA1",
      row_number() %in% 31:46 ~ "Regional",
      TRUE ~ "Remote"
    )
  ) |>
  select(Equity_Group, everything())

E_equity <- E_equity |>
  mutate(
    Year = as.integer(substr(as.character(Year), 1, 4))
  ) |>
  group_by(Equity_Group, Year) |>
  summarise(
    Success_Rate = mean(Success_Rate, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

E_spider <- E_equity |>
  mutate(
    Period = case_when(
      Year >= 2011 & Year <= 2013 ~ "2011–2013",
      Year >= 2014 & Year <= 2016 ~ "2014–2016",
      Year >= 2017 & Year <= 2019 ~ "2017–2019",
      Year >= 2020 & Year <= 2022 ~ "2020–2022",
      Year >= 2023 & Year <= 2024 ~ "2023–2024"
    )
  ) |>
  group_by(Equity_Group, Period) |>
  summarise(
    Success_Rate = mean(Success_Rate, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

E_radial <- E_equity |>
  group_by(Equity_Group) |>
  summarise(
    Mean_Success_Rate = mean(Success_Rate, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

E_radial_avg <- E_radial |>
  mutate(
    Radial_Value = Mean_Success_Rate - 60,
    label = paste0(
      Equity_Group, " - ",
      round(Mean_Success_Rate, 2), "%"
    )
  )
```

```{r G_donut_total Creation}
G_clean <-  G |> 
  select(1, 22:30) |> 
  slice(5:17) |> 
  slice(-c(1, 2, 3, 13))

names(G_clean) <- c(
  "Highest Educational Attainment",
  "NSW", "Vic", "Qld", "SA", "WA",
  "Tas", "NT", "ACT", "Aust"
)

G_clean <- G_clean |>
  mutate(
    across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 1))
  )

G_clean <- G_clean |>
  mutate(
    across(
      -`Highest Educational Attainment`,
      ~ round(as.numeric(.x), 1)
    )
  )

G_donut <- G_clean |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -`Highest Educational Attainment`,
    names_to = "State",
    values_to = "Count"
  ) |>
  group_by(State) |>
  mutate(
    Percentage = Count / sum(Count) * 100
  ) |>
  ungroup()

G_donut_total <- G_donut |>
  filter(State == "Aust")

G_donut_total <- G_donut_total |>
  mutate(
    `Highest Educational Attainment` = if_else(
      `Highest Educational Attainment` %in% c(
        "Year 11",
        "Year 10",
        "Year 9 or below(b)(c)"
      ),
      "Year 11 or below",
      `Highest Educational Attainment`
    )
  ) |>
  group_by(`Highest Educational Attainment`) |>
  summarise(
    Count = sum(Count),
    Percentage = sum(Percentage),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r Donut Chart Tab 3}
ggplot(G_donut_total, aes(x = 2, y = Percentage,
                          fill = reorder(`Highest Educational Attainment`, Percentage))) +
  geom_col(width = 1, colour = "white") +
  coord_polar(theta = "y") +
  xlim(0.5, 2.5) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = paste0(round(Percentage, 1), "%")),
    position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
    size = 3
  ) +
  labs(fill = "Education level") +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_text(colour = "#243B53"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10, colour = "#243B53")
  )
```


```{r G_spider_plot Creation} 
G_spider <- G_clean |>
  filter(
    `Highest Educational Attainment` %in% c(
      "Postgraduate Degree",
      "Graduate Diploma/Graduate Certificate",
      "Bachelor Degree"
    )
  ) |>
  select(-`Highest Educational Attainment`) |>
  summarise(across(everything(), sum)) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = everything(),
    names_to = "State",
    values_to = "Count"
  ) |>
  filter(State != "Aust")

G_spider <- G_spider |>
  mutate(
    State = if_else(
      State %in% c("Tas", "NT", "ACT"),
      "Other states/territories",
      State
    )
  ) |>
  group_by(State) |>
  summarise(Count = sum(Count), .groups = "drop")

G_spider <- G_spider |>
  arrange(Count)

G_spider_plot <- G_spider |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = State,
    values_from = Count
  )

G_spider_plot <- rbind(
  max = rep(2400, ncol(G_spider_plot)),
  min = rep(300, ncol(G_spider_plot)),
  G_spider_plot
)

```

```{r H_males_wide & H_females_wide Creation}
H_males <-  H |> 
  slice(55:87) |> 
  slice(1:16) |> 
  slice(1, 3, 11) |> 
   rename(
    `Educational Qualification Type` = 1,
    `Employed full-time` = 2,
    `Employed part-time` = 3,
    `Total employed` = 4,
    `Unemployed` = 5,
    `Inlabour Force` = 6,
    `Not in labour Force` = 7,
    `Total` = 8
  ) |> 
  slice(2,3) |>
  mutate(across(
    -`Educational Qualification Type`,
    ~ round(as.numeric(as.character(.x)), 1)
  ))

H_males_long <- H_males |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -`Educational Qualification Type`,
    names_to = "Employment",
    values_to = "Percentage"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    Percentage = as.numeric(Percentage),
    Qualification = if_else(
      str_detect(`Educational Qualification Type`, "without"),
      "Without a non-school qualification",
      "With a non-school qualification"
    )
  )

H_males_wide <- H_males_long |>
   filter(Employment != "Total") |>
  select(Employment, Qualification, Percentage) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Qualification,

  )

H_females <- H |>

H_females_long <- H_females |>
```

```{r H_dumbell Creation}
H_total <-  H |> 
  slice(89, 97) |> 
  select(-8)

names(H_total) <- c(
  "Educational Attainment",
  "Employed full time",
  "Employed part time",
  "Total Employed",
  "Unemployed",
  "In Labour Force",
  "Not In Labour Force"
)

H_total <- H_total |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    dplyr::across(
      2:7,
      ~ round(as.numeric(as.character(.x)), 1)
    )
  )

H_dumbbell <- H_total |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = -`Educational Attainment`,
    names_to = "Employment",
    values_to = "Proportion"
  ) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = `Educational Attainment`,
    values_from = Proportion
  ) |>
  dplyr::rename(
    With = `Total with a non-school qualification(b)`,
    Without = `Total without a non-school qualification`
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Employment = factor(
      Employment,
      levels = c(
        "Employed full time",
        "Employed part time",
        "Total Employed",
        "Unemployed",
        "In Labour Force",
        "Not In Labour Force"
      )
    )
  )
```

```{r Dumbell Chart Tab 3}
p_H_dumbbell <- ggplot(
  H_dumbbell,
  aes(y = Employment)
) +
  geom_segment(
    aes(x = Without, xend = With, yend = Employment),
    color = "#C4A7B5",
    linewidth = 1.2
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(x = With, color = "With qualification"),
    size = 3.5
  ) +
  geom_point(
```

```{r IJK_gap Creation}
IJK_long <- bind_rows(I_long, J_long, K_long) |>
  relocate(`Course Type`, .after = `Citizenship Type`)

IJK_plot <- IJK_long |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = `2025`:`2016`,
    names_to = "Year",
    values_to = "Employment_Rate"
  ) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = `Citizenship Type`,
    values_from = Employment_Rate
  ) |>
  mutate(Year = as.integer(Year))

IJK_plot <- IJK_plot |>
  mutate(
    Domestic = as.numeric(Domestic),
    International = as.numeric(International)
  )

IJK_gap <- IJK_plot |>
  mutate(
    Employment_Gap = Domestic - International
  )
```

```{r LMN_bubble Creation}
LMN_long <- bind_rows(L_long, M_long, N_long) |>

LMN_plot <- LMN_long |>
  pivot_longer(

    values_to = "Median_Annual_Salaries"
  ) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = `Citizenship Type`,
    values_from = Median_Annual_Salaries
  ) |>
  mutate(Year = as.integer(Year))

LMN_plot <- LMN_plot |>
  mutate(
    Domestic = readr::parse_number(Domestic),
    International = readr::parse_number(International)
  )

LMN_bubble <- LMN_plot |>
  mutate(
    Salary_Gap = abs(Domestic - International)
  )
```

```{r}
LMN_salary_long <- LMN_bubble |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Domestic, International),
    names_to = "Student.Type",
    values_to = "Salary"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Group = paste(Course.Type, Student.Type, sep = " - ")
  )

```

```{r}

salary_order <- c(
  "Undergraduate - International",
  "Undergraduate - Domestic",
  "Postgraduate Coursework - International",
  "Postgraduate Research - International",
  "Postgraduate Coursework - Domestic",
  "Postgraduate Research - Domestic"
)

salary_smooth <- LMN_salary_long |>
  mutate(Group = factor(Group, levels = salary_order)) |>
  group_by(Group) |>
  group_modify(\(data, key) {
    model <- loess(Salary ~ Year, data = data)
    new_year <- seq(2016, 2025, length.out = 200)

    tibble(
      Year = new_year,
      Salary = as.numeric(
        predict(model, newdata = data.frame(Year = new_year))
      )
    )
  }) |>
  ungroup()


salary_bands <- salary_smooth |>
  arrange(Year, Group) |>
  group_by(Year) |>
  mutate(
    ymin = lag(Salary, default = 0),
    ymax = Salary
  ) |>
  ungroup()
```

```{r Salary Area Chart Tab 3}

salary_palette <- c(
 "Undergraduate - International" = "#243B53",
  "Undergraduate - Domestic" = "#8F2948",
  "Postgraduate Coursework - International" = "#527A9D",
  "Postgraduate Coursework - Domestic" = "#C05A78",
  "Postgraduate Research - International" = "#A9C3D9",
  "Postgraduate Research - Domestic" = "#E8A4B5"
)

p_salary <- ggplot(salary_bands) +
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(
    x = Year,
    ymin = pmax(ymin, 30000),
    ymax = pmax(ymin, pmin(ymax, 110000)),
    fill = Group,
    group = Group
  ),
  alpha = 0.72,
  colour = NA
  ) +
  geom_line(
    aes(x = Year, y = Salary, colour = Group),
    linewidth = 1.25,
    alpha = 1
  ) +
 scale_fill_manual(
  values = salary_palette,
  breaks = salary_order
) +
scale_colour_manual(
  values = salary_palette,
  breaks = salary_order
) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = 2016:2025,
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.01))
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
     limits = c(30000, 110000),
  breaks = seq(30000, 110000, by = 10000),
  labels = scales::label_dollar(
    prefix = "$",
    big.mark = ",",
    accuracy = 1000
    ),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.04))
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Graduate Salary Trends",
    subtitle = "Domestic and international graduates by course type, 2016–2025",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Annual salary",
    fill = NULL,
    colour = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "#FFFAF7", colour = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#FFFAF7", colour = NA),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),

    ),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(colour = "#6D597A"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.key.width = grid::unit(1.2, "cm"),
    plot.margin = margin(12, 16, 8, 8)
  )
```
